verses.translation: Now Benjamin begot Bale his first-born, and Asbel his second son, Aara the third, Noa the fourth,

translations.ron: Lui Veniamin i s-a născut Bela, întâiul său născut; al doilea, Aşbel, al treilea, Ahrah,
translations.grk: Καὶ Βενιαμὶν ἐγέννησε Βαλὲ πρωτότοκον αὐτοῦ, καὶ ʼΑσβὴλ τὸν δεύτερον, Ἀαρὰ τὸν τρίτον,

verses.translation: and Rapha the fifth.

translations.ron: Al patrulea, Noha şi al cincilea, Rafa.
translations.grk: Νωὰ τὸν τέταρτον, καὶ Ῥαφὰ τὸν πέμπτον.

verses.translation: And the sons of Bale were, Adir, and Gera, and Abiud,

translations.ron: Fiii lui Bela au fost: Adar, Ghera, Abiud,
translations.grk: Καὶ ἦσαν υἱοὶ τῷ Βαλὲ, Ἀδὶρ, καὶ Γηρὰ, καὶ Ἀβιοὺδ,

verses.translation: and Abessue, and Noama, and Achia,

translations.ron: Abişua, Naaman, Ahoah,
translations.grk: καὶ Ἀβεσσουὲ, καὶ Νοαμὰ, καὶ Ἀχιὰ,

verses.translation: and Gera, and Sephupham, and Uram.

translations.ron: Ghera, Şefufan şi Huram.
translations.grk: καὶ Γερὰ, καὶ Σεφουφὰμ, καὶ Οὐράμ.

verses.translation: These were the sons of Aod: these are the heads of families to them that dwell in Gabee, and they removed them to Machanathi:

translations.ron: Iată fiii lui Ehud, care au fost capi de familii, care au trăit în Gheba şi au fost strămutaţi în Manahat:
translations.grk: Οὗτοι υἱοὶ Ἀὼδ, οὗτοί εἰσιν ἄρχοντες πατριῶν τοῖς κατοικοῦσι Γαβεέ· καὶ μετῴκισαν αὐτοὺς εἰς Μαχαναθὶ,

verses.translation: and Nooma, and Achia and Gera, he removed them, and he begot Aza, and Jachicho.

translations.ron: Naaman, Ahia şi Ghera, care i-a strămutat, a născut pe Uza şi pe Ahiud.
translations.grk: καὶ Νοομὰ, καὶ Ἀχιὰ, καὶ Γηρά· οὗτος ἰεγλαὰμ, καὶ ἐγέννησε τὸν ʼΑζὰ, καὶ τὸν Ἰαχιχώ.

verses.translation: And Saarin begot children in the plain of Moab, after that he had sent away Osin and Baada his wives.

translations.ron: Lui Şaharaim i s-au născut copii în ţara Moabiţilor, după ce a dat drumul femeilor sale, Huşim şi Baara.
translations.grk: Καὶ Σααρὶν ἐγέννησεν ἐν τῷ πεδίῳ Μωὰβ μετὰ τὸ ἀποστεῖλαι αὐτὸν ʼΩσὶν καὶ τὴν Βααδὰ γυναῖκα αὐτοῦ.

verses.translation: And he begot of his wife Ada, Jolab, and Sebia, and Misa, and Melchas,

translations.ron: I s-au născut din Hodeşa, femeia sa: Iobab, Ţibia, Meşa şi Malcam;
translations.grk: Καὶ ἐγέννησεν ἐκ τῆς ʼΑδὰ γυναικὸς αὐτοῦ τὸν Ἰωλὰβ, καὶ τὸν Σεβιὰ, καὶ τὸν Μισὰ, καὶ τὸν Μελχὰς,

verses.translation: and Jebus, and Zabia, and Marma: these were heads of families.

translations.ron: Ieuţ, Şachia şi Mirma. Aceştia sunt fiii lui, capi de familie.
translations.grk: καὶ τὸν Ἰεβοὺς, καὶ τὸν Ζαβιὰ καὶ τὸν Μαρμά· οὗτοι ἄρχοντες πατριῶν.

verses.translation: And of Osin he begot Abitol, and Alphaal.

translations.ron: Din Huşim i s-au născut Abitub şi Elpaal.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἐκ τῆς Ὠσὶν ἐγέννησε τὸν Ἀβιτὼλ, καὶ τὸν Ἀλφαάλ.

verses.translation: And the sons of Alphaal; Obed, Misaal, Semmer: he built Ona, and Lod, and its towns:

translations.ron: Fiii lui Elpaal au fost: Eber, Mişeam şi Şemed, care au zidit Ono şi Lodul şi cetăţile ce ţineau de el,
translations.grk: Καὶ υἱοὶ Ἀλφαὰλ, Ὠβὴδ, Μισαὰλ, Σεμμήρ· οὗτος ᾠκοδόμησε τὴν Ὠνὰν, καὶ τὴν Λὼδ καὶ τὰς κώμας αὐτῆς·

verses.translation: and Beria, and Sama; these were heads of families among the dwellers in Elam, and they drove out the inhabitants of Geth.

translations.ron: Precum şi Beria şi Sema. - Aceştia au fost capii familiilor locuitorilor Aialonului; ei au alungat pe locuitorii din Gat. -
translations.grk: Καὶ Βεριὰ, καὶ Σαμά· οὗτοι ἄρχοντες τῶν πατριῶν τοῖς κατοικοῦσιν Αἰλὰμ, καὶ οὗτοι ἐξεδίωξαν τοὺς κατοικοῦντας Γέθ.

verses.translation: And his brethren were Sosec, and Arimoth,

translations.ron: Ahio, Şaşac, şi Iremot;
translations.grk: καὶ ἀδελφὸς αὐτοῦ Σωσὴκ, καὶ ʼΑριμὼθ,

verses.translation: and Zabadia, and Ored, and Eder,

translations.ron: Zebadia, Arad şi Eder;
translations.grk: καὶ Ζαβαδία, καὶ Ὠρὴδ, καὶ Ἔδερ,

verses.translation: and Michael, and Jespha, and Joda, the sons of Beria:

translations.ron: Micael, Işpa şi Ioha, fiii lui Beria.
translations.grk: καὶ Μιχαὴλ, καὶ ʼΙεσφὰ, καὶ Ἰωδὰ, υἱοὶ Βεριά.

verses.translation: and Zabadia, and Mosollam, and Azaki, and Abar,

translations.ron: Zecadia, Meşulam, Hizchi şi Heber,
translations.grk: Καὶ Ζαβαδία, καὶ Μοσολλὰμ, καὶ Ἀζακὶ, καὶ Ἀβὰρ,

verses.translation: and Isamari, and Jexlias, and Jobab, the sons of Elphaal:

translations.ron: Ieşmere, Izliah şi Iobab, fiii lui Elpaal.
translations.grk: καὶ Ἰσαμαρὶ, καὶ Ἰεξλίας, καὶ Ἰωβὰβ, υἱοὶ Ἐλφαάλ.

verses.translation: and Jakim, and Zachri, and Zabdi,

translations.ron: Iachim, Zicri şi Zabdi,
translations.grk: Καὶ Ἰακὶμ, καὶ Ζαχρὶ, καὶ Ζαβδὶ,

verses.translation: and Elionai, and Salathi,

translations.ron: Elienai, Ţiltai şi Eliel,
translations.grk: καὶ Ἐλιωναῒ, καὶ Σαλαθὶ, καὶ Ἐλιηλὶ,

verses.translation: and Elieli, and Adaia, and Baraia, and Samarath, sons of Samaith:

translations.ron: Adaia, Beraia şi Şimrat, fiii lui Şimei.
translations.grk: καὶ Ἀδαΐα, καὶ Βαραΐα, καὶ Σαμαρὰθ, υἱοὶ Σαμαΐθ.

verses.translation: and Jesphan, and Obed, and Eliel,

translations.ron: Işpan, Eber şi Eliel,
translations.grk: καὶ Ἰεσφὰν, καὶ Ὠβὴδ, καὶ Ἐλεὴλ,

verses.translation: and Abdon, and Zechri, and Anan,

translations.ron: Abdon, Zicri şi Hanan,
translations.grk: καὶ Ἀβδὼν, καὶ Ζεχρὶ, καὶ Ἀνὰν,

verses.translation: and Anania, and Ambri, and Ælam, and Anathoth,

translations.ron: Hanania, Elam şi Antotia,
translations.grk: καὶ Ἀνανία, καὶ Ἀμβρὶ, καὶ Αἰλὰμ, καὶ Ἀναθὼθ,

verses.translation: and Jathin, and Jephadias, and Phanuel, the sons of Sosec:

translations.ron: Ifdia şi Fanuil, fiii lui Şişac.
translations.grk: καὶ Ἰαθὶν, καὶ Ἰεφαδίας, καὶ Φανουὴλ, υἱοὶ Σωσήκ.

verses.translation: and Samsari, and Saarias, and Gotholia,

translations.ron: Şamşerai, Şeharia şi Atalia,
translations.grk: Καὶ Σαμσαρὶ, καὶ Σααρίας, καὶ Γοθολία,

verses.translation: and Jarasia, and Eria, and Zechri, son of Iroam.

translations.ron: Iaareşia, Elia şi Zicri, fiii lui Ieroham.
translations.grk: καὶ Ἰαρασία, καὶ Ἐριὰ, καὶ Ζεχρὶ υἱὸς Ἰροάμ.

verses.translation: These were heads of families, chiefs according to their generations: these dwelt in Jerusalem.

translations.ron: Acestea sunt căpeteniile familiilor mai de seamă ale neamului lor. Ei au locuit în Ierusalim.
translations.grk: Οὗτοι ἄρχοντες πατριῶν κατὰ γενέσεις αὐτῶν ἄρχοντες· οὗτοι κατῴκησαν ἐν Ἱερουσαλήμ.

verses.translation: And the father of Gabaon dwelt in Gabaon; and his wife's name was Moacha.

translations.ron: În Ghibeon a trăit Ieguel, tatăl Ghibeoniţilor. Numele femeii lui a fost Maaca
translations.grk: Καὶ ἐν Γαβαὼν κατῴκησε πατὴρ Γαβαών· καὶ ὄνομα γυναικὶ αὐτοῦ Μοαχά.

verses.translation: And her first-born son was Abdon, and Sur, and Kis, and Baal, and Nadab, and Ner,

translations.ron: Şi fiul lui, întâiul născut, Abdon, după el Ţur, Chiş, Baal, Nadab, Ner,
translations.grk: Καὶ ὁ υἱὸς αὐτῆς ὁ πρωτότοκος Ἀβδὼν, καὶ Σοὺρ, καὶ Κὶς, καὶ Βαὰλ, καὶ Ναδὰβ,

verses.translation: and Gedur and his brother, and Zacchur, and Makeloth.

translations.ron: Ghedeor, Ahio, Zecher şi Miclot;
translations.grk: καὶ Νὴρ, καὶ Γεδοὺρ καὶ ἀδελφὸς αὐτοῦ, καὶ Ζακχοὺρ, καὶ Μακελώθ.

verses.translation: And Makeloth begot Samaa: for these dwelt in Jerusalem in the presence of their brethren with their brethren.

translations.ron: Lui Miclot i s-a născut Şimea. Şi au trăit ei împreună cu fraţii lor în Ierusalim.
translations.grk: Καὶ Μακελὼθ ἐγέννησε τὸν Σαμαά· καὶ γὰρ οὗτοι κατέναντι τῶν ἀδελφῶν αὐτῶν κατῴκησαν ἐν Ἱερουσαλὴμ μετὰ τῶν ἀδελφῶν αὐτῶν.

verses.translation: And Ner begot Kis, and Kis begot Saul, and Saul begot Jonathan, and Melchisue, and Aminadab, and Asabal.

translations.ron: Lui Ner i s-a născut Chiş; lui Chiş i s-a născut Saul; lui Saul i s-a născut Ionatan, Melchişua, Aminadab şi Eşbaal.
translations.grk: Καὶ Νὴρ ἐγέννησε τὸν Κὶς, καὶ Κὶς ἐγέννησε τὸν Σαοὺλ, καὶ Σαοὺλ ἐγέννησε τὸν Ἰωνάθαν, καὶ τὸν Μελχισουὲ, καὶ τὸν Ἀμιναδὰβ, καὶ τὸν Ἀσαβάλ.

verses.translation: And the son of Jonathan was Meribaal; and Meribaal begot Micha.

translations.ron: Fiul lui Ionatan a fost Meribaal; (Mefiboşet); a avut de fiu pe Mica.
translations.grk: καὶ υἱὸς Ἰωνάθαν Μεριβαάλ· καὶ Μεριβαὰλ ἐγέννησε τὸν Μιχά.

verses.translation: And the sons of Micha; Phithon, and Melach, and Tharach, and Achaz.

translations.ron: Fiii lui Mica au fost: Piton, Melec, Tarea şi Ahaz.
translations.grk: καὶ υἱοὶ Μιχὰ, Φιθὼν, καὶ Μελὰχ, καὶ Θαρὰχ, καὶ Ἀχάζ.

verses.translation: And Achaz begot Jada, and Jada begot Salæmath, and Asmoth, and Zambri; and Zambri begot Mæsa;

translations.ron: Lui Ahaz i s-a născut Iehoada, lui Iehoada i s-a născut Alemet, Asmavet şi Zimri; lui Zimri i s-a născut Moţa;
translations.grk: καὶ Ἀχὰζ ἐγέννησε τὸν Ἰαδά· καὶ Ἰαδὰ ἐγέννησε τὸν Σαλαιμὰθ, καὶ τὸν Ἀσμὼθ, καὶ τὸν Ζαμβρί· καὶ Ζαμβρὶ ἐγέννησε τὸν Μαισά.

verses.translation: and Mæsa begot Baana: Rhaphæa, was his son, Elasa his son, Esel his son.

translations.ron: Lui Moţa i s-a născut Binea; Rafa, fiul lui; Eleasa, fiul lui; Aţel, fiul lui.
translations.grk: Καὶ Μαισὰ ἐγέννησε τὸν Βαανά· Ῥαφαία υἱὸς αὐτοῦ, Ἐλασὰ υἱὸς αὐτοῦ, Ἐσὴλ υἱὸς αὐτοῦ.

verses.translation: And Esel had six sons, and these were their names; Ezricam his first-born, and Ismael, and Saraia, and Abdia, and Anan, and Asa: all these were the sons of Esel.

translations.ron: Aţel a avut şase feciori şi iată numele lor: Azricam, Bocru, Ismael, Şearia, Obadia şi Hanan. Toţi aceştia sunt fiii lui Aţel.
translations.grk: Καὶ τῷ Ἐσὴλ ἓξ υἱοί· καὶ ταῦτα τὰ ὀνόματα αὐτῶν· Ἐζρικὰμ πρωτότοκος αὐτοῦ, καὶ Ἰσμαὴλ, καὶ Σαραΐα, καὶ Ἀβδία, καὶ Ἀνὰν, καὶ Ἀσά· πάντες οὗτοι υἱοὶ Ἐσήλ.

verses.translation: And the sons of Asel his brother; Ælam his first-born, and Jas the second, and Eliphalet the third.

translations.ron: Fiii lui Eşec, fratele său, au fost: Ulam, întâiul său născut; al doilea, Ieuş; al treilea Elifelet.
translations.grk: Καὶ υἱοὶ Ἀσὴλ ἀδελφοῦ αὐτοῦ, Αἰλὰμ πρωτότοκος αὐτοῦ, καὶ Ἰὰς ὁ δεύτερος, καὶ Ἐλιφαλὲτ ὁ τρίτος.

verses.translation: And the sons of Ælam were mighty men, bending the bow, and multiplying sons and grandsons, a hundred and fifty. All these were of the sons of Benjamin.

translations.ron: Fiii lui Ulam au fost oameni războinici, trăgători din arc, având mulţi copii şi nepoţi până la o sută cincizeci. Toţi aceştia sunt din fiii lui Veniamin.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἦσαν υἱοὶ Αἰλὰμ ἰσχυροὶ ἄνδρες δυνάμει, τείνοντες τόξον, καὶ πληθύνοντες υἱοὺς καὶ υἱοὺς τῶν υἱῶν, ἑκατὸν πεντήκοντα· πάντες οὗτοι ἐξ υἱῶν Βενιαμίν.
